objective: Owned equipment supporting at least ten simultaneous human gestations from embryos supplied upstream without human surrogates, with ten children's births on the same defined calendar date, independently assessed development and continuing health; separately qualified AI/robot-assisted parenting, tall physical stature and strong intellectual/practical skills. Seek the earliest achievable outcome, preferably within two to three years of 2026-10-11 or sooner (2028-10-11 to 2029-10-11). Five years is a comparison scenario; ten years may be tolerable. No supported completion forecast or success guarantee is asserted; longitudinal outcomes continue after birth.

constraints.longitudinal_outcomes_due: At prespecified ages after birth; separate from the equipment and birth target

constraints.parenting_goal: Material AI/robot assistance, qualified by specific capability and actual-setting evidence
constraints.growth_goal: Physically tall over development; age-specific targets not yet defined

constraints.mission: Technical achievement of owned simultaneous ectogenesis and care capabilities; political/religious argument outside scope
